</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macro Headwinds:</strong> India&#x27;s inflation at 4.8% maintains a hawkish RBI outlook, while the rupee continues its slide, weakening for the sixth consecutive session to 95.88 against the US dollar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
